profile.name: Rindi Tri Setyaningsih
profile.headline: GIS & Data Analyst
profile.intro: GIS and Data Analyst with a background in Geographic Information Systems, specializing in geospatial analysis, spatial data, data visualization, and web-based mapping. I enjoy transforming complex data into clear insights and practical solutions.
profile.about:
I am a Geographic Information Systems graduate from Universitas Gadjah Mada with an interest in data analytics, geospatial analysis, data visualization, and web GIS development. My background combines spatial thinking with programming and data-driven problem solving.

I work with geospatial and structured data to support analysis, visualization, and decision-making. Through academic projects, internships, and community-based projects, I have gained experience working with GIS, spatial databases, remote sensing, web mapping, and data visualization.
profile.contactText: Open to opportunities in data analytics, GIS, geospatial analysis, data visualization, and related roles.
